config.method: percentile bootstrap over test tweets, paired, chunked
config.not_covered: training randomness beyond the random subsets; one training run per cell

H1.rule: |mean gap LexFront-NLTK| (LR, default, clean) at the largest size < at the smallest size

H2.rule: (LexFront heavy - clean accuracy) - (NLTK heavy - clean), LR, default, full data: CI excludes 0 and is positive

H3.rule: |LexFront-NLTK accuracy difference| (LR, clean, full data) smaller with tuned than with default settings
